From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: HelixCare activation: transfer notes & primary owner

Hi team,

Quick handoff note for HelixCare (closed deal; SOW signed 2026-11-18). High-level summary: $1.2M ARR committed for Dedicated capacity + Redwood Optimize add-on. Go-live target: 2026-12-15 (customer requested tight timeline).

Key HelixCare contacts:
- Jordan Lee (VP Product) - jordan.lee@helixcare.io
- Michael Cho (Security/Infra) - mcho@helixcare.io
- procurement@helixcare.io

Technical constraints / hard requirements:
- SAML SSO (Okta) required for all user roles
- VPC peering into us-east-1; customer will supply network ranges and security contacts
- Data residency: production in us-east-1 only (no EU replicas)
- Model variant: prefer 7B quantized; fallback to 13B if latency unacceptable

Attached: HelixCare_SOW_signed.pdf, HelixCare_Onboarding_Risks.xlsx, network_peering_sketch.png (high-level).

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation:
1) Assign primary CSM and technical lead (ownership + single point-of-contact).
2) Kickoff call with customer (45–60m) by week of Nov 29 if possible; customer prefers early Dec as alternate.
3) Validate SSO and networking timelines (they said security/infra will engage this week).
4) Confirm acceptance criteria & runbook owner for cutover validation window.

Notes / risks:
- Procurement expects to issue PO by end of month, but any delay might push go-live.
- Customer asked for SOC2 Type II evidence and a brief on retention policy (they flagged under compliance).

Sofia — can you own CS intake and propose primary owner? Tessa/Vivek — please review the technical asks and flag anything you need from me.

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

I will own the CS intake and coordinate the internal kickoff, but I want Tessa to be the primary CSM on the account day-to-day. Vivek — please be the technical lead for the VMware/VPC peering & runtime tuning.

Triage / next steps from my side:
- Opened intake ticket: JIRA-4321 (CS intake + implementation checklist).
- Assigned Tessa as primary CSM and Vivek as Tech Lead in the ticket.
- I’ll schedule the customer kickoff; propose Dec 1 or Dec 2 (window: 10:00–11:00 PT or 13:00–14:00 ET works for our team).
- I’ll share SOC2 artifacts and our retention summary prior to the meeting.

Tessa — please confirm you can take ownership and propose a kickoff agenda (I put a rough template in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/helixcare-onboarding).

Marissa — FYI in case we need to loop in solutions engineering for special kernel tuning.

Jordan / Michael — looping you in as I'm taking primary CSM ownership for HelixCare. Thanks Aditya & Sofia for the handoff.

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 9:14 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com> wrote:
> I will own the CS intake and coordinate the internal kickoff...

I accept primary ownership and will run the kickoff and subsequent sprints. Proposed kickoff: Dec 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (45–60m). Please confirm availability.

Pre-kickoff asks (items we'll cover / need before call):
- SAML metadata (IdP XML) for Okta test tenant or staging SSO config.
- Network contact + CIDR blocks for VPC peering / firewall rules.
- Confirmation of the person who will approve acceptance criteria (who signs off at cutover).
- Any must-have compliance docs (SOC2 link preferred; we can provide SOC2 summary).

Internal next steps for our team (short list):
1) Draft runbook + validation checklist (owner: Vivek)
2) Create test plan for prefix/caching behavior (owner: Tessa)
3) Schedule a 2-week validation window after initial cutover (tentative: Dec 16–30)

I attached a kickoff agenda draft (kickoff_agenda_v1.docx) and will upload a more detailed runbook after the kickoff. Vivek — can you confirm you have bandwidth for the Dec 1 kickoff and the peering work in early Dec?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
